requirements.title: Picker-wheel desktop generation and validation
requirements.description: Picker-wheel serves as the canonical reference implementation for basic desktop generation

requirements.title: System-monitor advanced desktop generation
requirements.description: System-monitor demonstrates advanced template with system tray and background operation

requirements.title: Desktop apps connect to scenario APIs
requirements.description: Generated desktop apps successfully connect to and communicate with scenario backend APIs

requirements.title: Desktop apps load React UI from scenario ui/dist/
requirements.description: Generated desktop apps correctly load and display the scenario's built React UI

requirements.title: Provider and communication journeys report honest routes
requirements.description: Bundled-private, Tier 2 to Tier 1 thin-client, shared-resource, and private-fallback capabilities have dedicated machine contracts and credential-free provider observations; provider-neutral journey and release-gate semantics are owned by packages/delivery-ramp-go, while native release evidence remains environment-gated.

requirements.title: Tier 2 peer communication is fail-closed
requirements.description: The typed desktop-peer candidate cannot produce a pass verdict until discovery, authentication, scoped authority, routing, cancellation, and lifecycle semantics are implemented.

requirements.title: Bounded desktop packaging staging
requirements.description: Scenario to Desktop MUST enforce configurable age and retained-byte budgets over complete staging builds, use canonical storage paths, and protect active pipelines, builds, smoke tests and live desktop sessions.

requirements.title: Staging keeps artifacts outside scenario sources
requirements.description: When a staging or temporary pipeline runs, it MUST write generated artifacts outside the scenario source tree.

requirements.title: Smoke evidence targets an isolated instance
requirements.description: When a thin-client smoke test runs, it MUST target an identified isolated instance and MUST refuse the operator's live instance.

requirements.title: Evidence selects a mode-aware journey
requirements.description: When a desktop pipeline selects a deployment mode, it MUST record and execute the journey baseline for that mode.

requirements.title: Evidence retains unexecuted chapters
requirements.description: When a journey stops before completion, the evidence sidecar MUST retain every planned chapter with unexecuted chapters marked `not_run`.

requirements.title: Evidence gates use independent signals
requirements.description: When a manifest is produced, each required gate MUST use its own predicate and MUST NOT copy another gate or a constant result.

requirements.title: Demo release follows app readiness
requirements.description: When a visual demo starts, it MUST publish its release marker only after the application-ready signal and MUST respect the configured hold ceiling.

requirements.title: Evidence reports anchored process roles
requirements.description: When process metrics are collected, the monitor MUST classify the anchored application tree with the documented role taxonomy and report uncertain roles as `unknown`.

requirements.title: Unsafe evidence is voided and retained
requirements.description: When evidence is unsafe or superseded, the producer MUST record a void reason and successor reference without deleting the capture.
